datasets.title: Cassiopeia A in the near infrared
datasets.description: ESA/Webb's NIRCam picture of Cassiopeia A, at 1.62, 3.56 and 4.44 µm. The remnant's ejecta expand freely, so a speed along the sight line is a depth (DeLaney et al. 2010). Where Spitzer's [Ar II] spectra measure a speed, the picture's fine detail is at that depth: in front of the picture's plane where the ejecta approach, behind it where they recede. The smooth light lies on the forward shock's sphere: its broad glow on both halves, the rest on the far half, since one picture cannot tell the halves apart.
datasets.summary: Webb's picture as a shell: smooth light on the forward shock's sphere, ejecta at the depths their measured speeds give.
